## 1. Loading data

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Prepare model training datasets for safe drinking water
# subcomponents
# ============================================================
#
# Outputs:
#   ./data/training_subcomponents/ecoli_free_training_with_covariates.csv
#   ./data/training_subcomponents/improved_source_training_with_covariates.csv
#   ./data/training_subcomponents/availability_training_with_covariates.csv
#   ./data/training_subcomponents/accessibility_training_with_covariates.csv
#
# Crosswalk review files:
#   ./data/crosswalk_review/


library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(fuzzyjoin)
library(stringdist)
library(stringi)

source(here::here("./functions/create_indicators.R"))
source(here::here("./functions/join_and_structure_dataframes.R"))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
# Read household survey inputs
# ============================================================

df.water_quality_overview <- readOverviewWaterQualityData()

df.MICS_HH_SMDW_new <- readHouseHoldSurveyData_SMDW_new() #with water quality data
df.MICS_HH_SMDW_old <- readHouseHoldSurveyData_SMDW_old() #with water quality data
df.DHS_HH_SMDW <- readHouseHoldSurveyData_SMDW_DHS() #with water quality data

df.DHS_HH_SMDW <- df.DHS_HH_SMDW %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    HH7_region = as.character(HH7_region)
  )

df.MICS_HH_SMDW_new_other <- readHouseHoldSurveyData_SMDW_new_other() #with data on other subcomponents (improved source, availability, accessibility)
df.DHS_HH_SMDW_other <- readHouseHoldSurveyData_SMDW_DHS_other() #with data on other subcomponents


#Adding information about source

df.MICS_HH_SMDW_new <- df.MICS_HH_SMDW_new  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(household_data_source = "MICS_water_quality")
df.MICS_HH_SMDW_old <- df.MICS_HH_SMDW_old  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(household_data_source = "MICS_water_quality")
df.DHS_HH_SMDW <- df.DHS_HH_SMDW  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(household_data_source = "DHS_water_quality")

df.MICS_HH_SMDW_new_other <- df.MICS_HH_SMDW_new_other  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(household_data_source = "MICS_other")
df.DHS_HH_SMDW_other <- df.DHS_HH_SMDW_other  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(household_data_source = "DHS_other")


# Water-quality household data.
# These are used for E. coli and also included in the other subcomponents.
df_hh_water_quality <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  df.MICS_HH_SMDW_old,
  df.MICS_HH_SMDW_new,
  df.DHS_HH_SMDW
)


# Other household surveys.
# These are used for improved source, availability, and accessibility.
df_hh_other <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  df.MICS_HH_SMDW_old,
  df.MICS_HH_SMDW_new,
  df.MICS_HH_SMDW_new_other,
  df.DHS_HH_SMDW_other
  ) 


# ============================================================
# Read lookup and metadata inputs
# ============================================================

df.WGI_lmics <- readWGI_lmics()

country_name_key_WB <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("./data/country_name_key_WB.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

UN_region_key <- readr::read_delim(
  here::here("./data/UNSD—Methodology.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

df.prediction_nonpop <- readPredictionData_nonpop()
```

```{r}
# Remove countries with HH5Y outside 2015–2024
countries_HH5Y_outside_range <- df_hh_other %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(HH5Y),
    HH5Y < 2015 | HH5Y > 2024
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(country) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(country)

print(countries_HH5Y_outside_range)

df_hh_other <- df_hh_other %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    HH5Y_original = HH5Y,
    HH5Y = standardise_survey_year(country, HH5Y)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.na(HH5Y) | HH5Y >= 2015
  )
```

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarise survey years by country and data source
# ------------------------------------------------------------

country_source_summary <- df_hh_other %>%
  mutate(HH5Y = as.integer(HH5Y)) %>%
  group_by(country, household_data_source) %>%
  summarise(
    min_year = ifelse(all(is.na(HH5Y)), NA_integer_, min(HH5Y, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_year = ifelse(all(is.na(HH5Y)), NA_integer_, max(HH5Y, na.rm = TRUE)),
    survey_years = paste(sort(unique(HH5Y[!is.na(HH5Y)])), collapse = ", "),
    n_rows = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(country_source_summary)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Identify which data source to keep per country
# ------------------------------------------------------------

source_to_keep <- country_source_summary %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(!is.na(max_year)),  # prefer sources with year information
    desc(max_year),          # keep source with latest survey year
    desc(n_rows),            # if tied, keep source with more rows
    household_data_source
  ) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(country, household_data_source)

print(source_to_keep)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# see which sources will be dropped
# ------------------------------------------------------------

source_to_drop <- country_source_summary %>%
  anti_join(source_to_keep, by = c("country", "household_data_source")) %>%
  arrange(country, household_data_source)

print(source_to_drop)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Keep only one survey source per country
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df_hh_other <- df_hh_other %>%
  semi_join(
    source_to_keep,
    by = c("country", "household_data_source")
  )

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Build separate covariate tables
# ============================================================

df_training_covariates_wq <- make_training_covariates(
  pop_files = pop_files_wq,
  nonpop_files = FILE_NONPOP_WQ,
  covariate_cols = covariate_cols
)

df_training_covariates_other <- make_training_covariates(
  pop_files = pop_files_other,
  nonpop_files = FILE_NONPOP_OTHER,
  covariate_cols = covariate_cols
)

# Check for duplicate covariate keys.
# This should ideally return zero rows.
duplicate_covariate_keys_wq <- check_duplicate_covariate_keys(
  df_training_covariates_wq
)

duplicate_covariate_keys_other <- check_duplicate_covariate_keys(
  df_training_covariates_other
)

duplicate_covariate_keys_wq
duplicate_covariate_keys_other

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Create household input datasets
# ============================================================

df_hh_water_quality_for_ecoli <- df_hh_water_quality

df_hh_other_for_subcomponents <- df_hh_other
```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# Reviewed e.coli analysis-year fixes
# ============================================================

manual_analysis_year_fixes_ecoli <- tibble::tribble(
  ~country,                              ~analysis_year_manual,
  "Lao People's Democratic Republic",    2023L,
  "Palestina",                           2019L,
  "São Tomé and Príncipe",               2019L,
  "Zimbabwe",                            2019L
)

# ============================================================
# Create outcomes
# ============================================================

ecoli_outcome <- make_ecoli_regional_outcome(
  df_hh_water_quality_for_ecoli
)

improved_source_outcome <- make_improved_source_regional_outcome(
  df_hh_other_for_subcomponents
)

availability_outcome <- make_availability_regional_outcome(
  df_hh_other_for_subcomponents
)

accessibility_outcome <- make_accessibility_regional_outcome(
  df_hh_other_for_subcomponents
)
```

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Year lookups
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ecoli_year_lookup <- make_year_lookup_from_raw_household_data(
  df_hh_water_quality_for_ecoli,
  manual_analysis_year_fixes = manual_analysis_year_fixes_ecoli
)

other_year_lookup <- make_year_lookup_from_raw_household_data(
  df_hh_other_for_subcomponents
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Add n_PSU weights to outcome tables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ecoli_outcome <- add_n_psu_weight(
  hh_df = df_hh_water_quality_for_ecoli,
  outcome_df = ecoli_outcome,
  year_lookup = ecoli_year_lookup
)

improved_source_outcome <- add_n_psu_weight(
  hh_df = df_hh_other_for_subcomponents,
  outcome_df = improved_source_outcome,
  year_lookup = other_year_lookup
)

availability_outcome <- add_n_psu_weight(
  hh_df = df_hh_other_for_subcomponents,
  outcome_df = availability_outcome,
  year_lookup = other_year_lookup
)

accessibility_outcome <- add_n_psu_weight(
  hh_df = df_hh_other_for_subcomponents,
  outcome_df = accessibility_outcome,
  year_lookup = other_year_lookup
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Quick check
# ------------------------------------------------------------

n_psu_check <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  ecoli_outcome %>% dplyr::mutate(check_outcome = "ecoli_free"),
  improved_source_outcome %>% dplyr::mutate(check_outcome = "improved_source"),
  availability_outcome %>% dplyr::mutate(check_outcome = "availability"),
  accessibility_outcome %>% dplyr::mutate(check_outcome = "accessibility")
) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(check_outcome) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_rows = dplyr::n(),
    missing_n_psu = sum(is.na(n_psu)),
    min_n_psu = min(n_psu, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_n_psu = median(n_psu, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_n_psu = max(n_psu, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(n_psu_check)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Diagnose countries dropped during covariate filtering
# ------------------------------------------------------------

diagnose_country_year_filtering <- function(
    outcome_name,
    outcome_df,
    raw_covariates,
    filtered_covariates,
    country_name_key_WB
) {
  
  wb_lookup <- build_wb_country_lookup(country_name_key_WB)
  
  outcome_country_years <- outcome_df %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      outcome_name = outcome_name,
      country_outcome,
      country_key = clean_key(country_outcome),
      analysis_year = as.integer(analysis_year)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  raw_cov_country_years <- raw_covariates %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      country_cov = country,
      country_key = clean_key(country),
      analysis_year = as.integer(analysis_year)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  filtered_cov_country_years <- filtered_covariates %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      country_cov_filtered = country,
      country_key = clean_key(country),
      analysis_year = as.integer(analysis_year)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  outcome_country_years %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      raw_cov_country_years,
      by = c("country_key", "analysis_year")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::anti_join(
      filtered_cov_country_years,
      by = c("country_key", "analysis_year")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      wb_lookup,
      by = c("country_key" = "country_alias_key")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      likely_issue = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(country_wb) ~ "country not mapped in build_wb_country_lookup()",
        TRUE ~ "mapped, check another filtering issue"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(outcome_name, country_outcome, analysis_year)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Add GDP and secondary education to all SMDW training datasets
# Uses WB country lookup, but falls back to cleaned country names
# so countries like Nauru / Trinidad and Tobago are not skipped.
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Helper: create robust country join key
# ------------------------------------------------------------

add_country_join_key <- function(df, country_col, country_name_key_WB) {
  
  wb_lookup <- build_wb_country_lookup(country_name_key_WB)
  
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      country_alias_key = clean_key({{ country_col }})
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      wb_lookup,
      by = "country_alias_key"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # If country is not in WB lookup, keep cleaned country name as fallback
      country_join = dplyr::coalesce(country_wb, country_alias_key)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-country_alias_key, -country_wb)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read country-year covariates
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gdp_per_capita_2015 <- readr::read_csv(
  "~/switchdrive/Eawag/WorldBankProject/geospatial_covariates/gdp_per_capita_2015.csv"
)

secondary_education_years <- readr::read_csv(
  "~/switchdrive/Eawag/WorldBankProject/geospatial_covariates/secondary_education_years.csv"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Clean GDP data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gdp_clean <- gdp_per_capita_2015 %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    country_name = Country.Name,
    analysis_year = Year,
    gdp_per_capita_constant_2015_usd = `GDP per capita (constant 2015 US$)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    analysis_year = as.integer(analysis_year),
    gdp_per_capita_constant_2015_usd = as.numeric(gdp_per_capita_constant_2015_usd)
  ) %>%
  add_country_join_key(
    country_col = country_name,
    country_name_key_WB = country_name_key_WB
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    country_join,
    analysis_year,
    gdp_per_capita_constant_2015_usd
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Clean secondary education data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

education_clean <- secondary_education_years %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    country_name = Country.Name,
    analysis_year = Year,
    secondary_education_duration_years = `Secondary education, duration (years)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    analysis_year = as.integer(analysis_year),
    secondary_education_duration_years = as.numeric(secondary_education_duration_years)
  ) %>%
  add_country_join_key(
    country_col = country_name,
    country_name_key_WB = country_name_key_WB
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    country_join,
    analysis_year,
    secondary_education_duration_years
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Combine GDP and education into one country-year table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

country_year_covariates_clean <- gdp_clean %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    education_clean,
    by = c("country_join", "analysis_year")
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Helper to add GDP and education to training data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

add_country_year_covariates <- function(training_df) {
  
  training_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      analysis_year = as.integer(analysis_year)
    ) %>%
    add_country_join_key(
      country_col = country_outcome,
      country_name_key_WB = country_name_key_WB
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      country_year_covariates_clean,
      by = c("country_join", "analysis_year")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-country_join)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Add GDP and education to all SMDW outcome datasets
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ecoli_training_with_covariates <- add_country_year_covariates(
  ecoli_training_with_covariates
)

improved_source_training_with_covariates <- add_country_year_covariates(
  improved_source_training_with_covariates
)

availability_training_with_covariates <- add_country_year_covariates(
  availability_training_with_covariates
)

accessibility_training_with_covariates <- add_country_year_covariates(
  accessibility_training_with_covariates
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Check missing GDP / education after join
# ------------------------------------------------------------

check_missing_country_year_covariates <- function(training_df, outcome_name) {
  
  training_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.na(gdp_per_capita_constant_2015_usd) |
        is.na(secondary_education_duration_years)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      country_outcome,
      analysis_year,
      gdp_per_capita_constant_2015_usd,
      secondary_education_duration_years
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(outcome_type = outcome_name) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(country_outcome, analysis_year)
}

missing_country_year_covariates <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  check_missing_country_year_covariates(ecoli_training_with_covariates, "ecoli_free"),
  check_missing_country_year_covariates(improved_source_training_with_covariates, "improved_source"),
  check_missing_country_year_covariates(availability_training_with_covariates, "availability"),
  check_missing_country_year_covariates(accessibility_training_with_covariates, "accessibility")
)

print(missing_country_year_covariates)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Add country-level wastewater covariates to all SMDW training datasets
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read wastewater country-level covariates
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ww_country_raw <- readr::read_tsv(
  "~/switchdrive/Eawag/WorldBankProject/geospatial_covariates/Country_WWctr_Percentage.txt",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Robust country join helper
#    Uses WB lookup where possible, falls back to cleaned country names
# ------------------------------------------------------------

add_country_join_key_country_level <- function(df, country_col, country_name_key_WB) {
  
  wb_lookup <- build_wb_country_lookup(country_name_key_WB)
  
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      -dplyr::any_of(c("country_join", "country_alias_key", "country_wb"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      country_alias_key = clean_key({{ country_col }})
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      wb_lookup,
      by = "country_alias_key"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      country_join_raw = dplyr::coalesce(country_wb, country_alias_key),
      
      country_join_raw = dplyr::case_when(
        country_alias_key == "bolivia plurinational state of" ~ "Bolivia",
        country_alias_key == "congo dem republic" ~ "Congo, Dem. Rep.",
        country_alias_key == "congo rep" ~ "Congo, Rep.",
        country_alias_key == "cote d ivoire" ~ "Cote d'Ivoire",
        country_alias_key == "iran islamic republic of" ~ "Iran, Islamic Rep.",
        country_alias_key %in% c("lao peoples democratic republic", "lao people s democratic republic") ~ "Lao PDR",
        country_alias_key == "macedonia fyr" ~ "North Macedonia",
        country_alias_key == "sao tome and principe" ~ "Sao Tome and Principe",
        country_alias_key %in% c("swaziland", "eswatini") ~ "Eswatini",
        country_alias_key == "tanzania" ~ "Tanzania",
        country_alias_key == "venezuela bolivarian republic of" ~ "Venezuela, RB",
        country_alias_key %in% c("viet nam", "vietnam") ~ "Viet Nam",
        country_alias_key %in% c("west bank gaza", "west bank and gaza") ~ "West Bank and Gaza",
        TRUE ~ country_join_raw
      ),
      
      country_join = clean_key(country_join_raw)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-country_alias_key, -country_wb, -country_join_raw)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Clean wastewater country-level covariates
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ww_country_clean <- ww_country_raw %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    ww_country_name = Country,
    ww_region = Region,
    ww_economic_classification = Economic_Classification,
    ww_collection_percent = WWc_Percent,
    ww_treatment_percent = WWt_Percent,
    ww_reuse_percent = WWr_Percent
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ww_collection_percent = as.numeric(ww_collection_percent),
    ww_treatment_percent = as.numeric(ww_treatment_percent),
    ww_reuse_percent = as.numeric(ww_reuse_percent)
  ) %>%
  add_country_join_key_country_level(
    country_col = ww_country_name,
    country_name_key_WB = country_name_key_WB
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    country_join,
    ww_country_name,
    ww_region,
    ww_economic_classification,
    ww_collection_percent,
    ww_treatment_percent,
    ww_reuse_percent
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(country_join, .keep_all = TRUE)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Helper to add wastewater covariates to training data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

add_ww_country_covariates <- function(training_df) {
  
  training_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      -dplyr::any_of(c(
        "country_join",
        "ww_country_name",
        "ww_region",
        "ww_economic_classification",
        "ww_collection_percent",
        "ww_treatment_percent",
        "ww_reuse_percent"
      ))
    ) %>%
    add_country_join_key_country_level(
      country_col = country_outcome,
      country_name_key_WB = country_name_key_WB
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      ww_country_clean,
      by = "country_join"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-country_join)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Add wastewater covariates to all SMDW training datasets
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ecoli_training_with_covariates <- add_ww_country_covariates(
  ecoli_training_with_covariates
)

improved_source_training_with_covariates <- add_ww_country_covariates(
  improved_source_training_with_covariates
)

availability_training_with_covariates <- add_ww_country_covariates(
  availability_training_with_covariates
)

accessibility_training_with_covariates <- add_ww_country_covariates(
  accessibility_training_with_covariates
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Check missing wastewater covariates after join
# ------------------------------------------------------------

check_missing_ww_covariates <- function(training_df, outcome_name) {
  
  training_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.na(ww_collection_percent) |
        is.na(ww_treatment_percent) |
        is.na(ww_reuse_percent)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      country_outcome,
      ww_country_name,
      ww_collection_percent,
      ww_treatment_percent,
      ww_reuse_percent
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(outcome_type = outcome_name) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(country_outcome)
}

missing_ww_covariates <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  check_missing_ww_covariates(ecoli_training_with_covariates, "ecoli_free"),
  check_missing_ww_covariates(improved_source_training_with_covariates, "improved_source"),
  check_missing_ww_covariates(availability_training_with_covariates, "availability"),
  check_missing_ww_covariates(accessibility_training_with_covariates, "accessibility")
)

print(missing_ww_covariates)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Manually assign Kosovo ww_region
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fix_ww_region_manual <- function(training_df) {
  training_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ww_region = dplyr::case_when(
        country_outcome == "Kosovo" & is.na(ww_region) ~ "Eastern Europe & Central Asia",
        TRUE ~ ww_region
      )
    )
}

ecoli_training_with_covariates <- fix_ww_region_manual(ecoli_training_with_covariates)
improved_source_training_with_covariates <- fix_ww_region_manual(improved_source_training_with_covariates)
availability_training_with_covariates <- fix_ww_region_manual(availability_training_with_covariates)
accessibility_training_with_covariates <- fix_ww_region_manual(accessibility_training_with_covariates)
```

```{r}
      country_join = clean_key(country_join_raw)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-country_alias_key, -country_wb, -country_join_raw)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Clean WGI data: wide years -> long country-year table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

wgi_clean <- wgi_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(`Series.Name` %in% names(indicator_map)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    indicator = unname(indicator_map[`Series.Name`])
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::matches("^X20[0-9]{2}$"),
    names_to = "analysis_year",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    analysis_year = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(analysis_year, "^X")),
    value = as.numeric(value)
  ) %>%
  add_country_join_key_wgi(
    country_col = `Country.Name`,
    country_name_key_WB = country_name_key_WB
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    country_join,
    analysis_year,
    indicator,
    value
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = indicator,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Helper to add WGI indicators to any training dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------

add_wgi_covariates <- function(training_df) {
  
  training_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      -dplyr::any_of(c(
        "country_join",
        "governance_effectiveness",
        "control_of_corruption",
        "political_stability",
        "regulatory_quality",
        "rule_of_law",
        "voice_and_accountability"
      ))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      analysis_year = as.integer(analysis_year)
    ) %>%
    add_country_join_key_wgi(
      country_col = country_outcome,
      country_name_key_WB = country_name_key_WB
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      wgi_clean,
      by = c("country_join", "analysis_year")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-country_join)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Add WGI indicators to all SMDW training datasets
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ecoli_training_with_covariates <- add_wgi_covariates(
  ecoli_training_with_covariates
)

improved_source_training_with_covariates <- add_wgi_covariates(
  improved_source_training_with_covariates
)

availability_training_with_covariates <- add_wgi_covariates(
  availability_training_with_covariates
)

accessibility_training_with_covariates <- add_wgi_covariates(
  accessibility_training_with_covariates
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Check missing WGI values after join
# ------------------------------------------------------------

check_missing_wgi_covariates <- function(training_df, outcome_name) {
  
  training_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.na(governance_effectiveness) |
        is.na(control_of_corruption) |
        is.na(political_stability) |
        is.na(regulatory_quality) |
        is.na(rule_of_law) |
        is.na(voice_and_accountability)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      country_outcome,
      analysis_year,
      governance_effectiveness,
      control_of_corruption,
      political_stability,
      regulatory_quality,
      rule_of_law,
      voice_and_accountability
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(outcome_type = outcome_name) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(country_outcome, analysis_year)
}

missing_wgi_covariates <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  check_missing_wgi_covariates(ecoli_training_with_covariates, "ecoli_free"),
  check_missing_wgi_covariates(improved_source_training_with_covariates, "improved_source"),
  check_missing_wgi_covariates(availability_training_with_covariates, "availability"),
  check_missing_wgi_covariates(accessibility_training_with_covariates, "accessibility")
)

print(missing_wgi_covariates)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Plot distribution of observations across ww_region by outcome
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Combine all outcome training datasets
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ww_region_plot_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  ecoli_training_with_covariates %>%
    dplyr::mutate(outcome_type = "E. coli free"),
  
  improved_source_training_with_covariates %>%
    dplyr::mutate(outcome_type = "Improved source"),
  
  availability_training_with_covariates %>%
    dplyr::mutate(outcome_type = "Availability"),
  
  accessibility_training_with_covariates %>%
    dplyr::mutate(outcome_type = "Accessibility")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ww_region = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(ww_region),
      "Missing ww_region",
      ww_region
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(outcome_type, ww_region, name = "n_observations") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(outcome_type) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    percent_observations = 100 * n_observations / sum(n_observations)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. One plot per outcome: number of observations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_ww_region_counts <- function(outcome_name) {
  
  ww_region_plot_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(outcome_type == outcome_name) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = forcats::fct_reorder(ww_region, n_observations),
        y = n_observations
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col() +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste("Distribution across wastewater regions:", outcome_name),
      x = "Wastewater region",
      y = "Number of observations"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
}


plot_ww_region_counts("E. coli free")
plot_ww_region_counts("Improved source")
plot_ww_region_counts("Availability")
plot_ww_region_counts("Accessibility")
```
